title: Aries, stay for the middle
caption: for the aries who love the first chapter most

scenes.text: aries, stand still for this one.
mars gave you a match that lights on anything.
you're the first to text, the first to leave the party,
the first to say it out loud.
they call it reckless. really, it's courage in a hurry.
but here's the part nobody tells you.
the best things don't happen at the start.
they happen in the slow middle you keep skipping.
the third dinner. the dull tuesday. the second fight.
that's where someone actually gets to meet you.
it has to be mutual, so let them catch up.
you don't have to win love. just stay for it.
go easy on the gas tonight, ram.
